opportunities.title: Needs and offers
opportunities.subtitle: Publish your needs or capabilities and discover compatible parties. Contact and confidential documents stay in controlled data rooms.
opportunities.consent: I consent to listing this title, description, category and location to signed-in users for matching.
opportunities.privacy: Without consent, the record stays within your organization. Do not include personal contacts or confidential information in the description. Closing withdraws it from listings and matching.

assurance.title: Assurance & readiness
assurance.readinessNotice: Transparent checks of recorded inputs, with hard and soft constraints. This does not certify technical feasibility or investment readiness.
assurance.riskNotice: Likelihood and severity are declared on a 1–5 scale. Score = likelihood × severity. No probability or safety certification is inferred.
assurance.commercialNotice: Connect verified documents by a shared chain reference. Amounts are DZD on a consistent tax basis. Differences are review signals, not debt claims or collection instructions.
assurance.graphNotice: Only recorded references appear. A link documents an association and does not establish causality.

signals.INVOICE_ABOVE_ACCEPTANCE: Invoice exceeds recorded acceptance plus variations: review required.
signals.PAYMENT_DIFFERENCE: Recorded payment and invoice totals differ.

agri.title: Agricultural intelligence
agri.subtitle: Soil, crop and irrigation intelligence linked to reviewed sources and acquisition times. Satellite indices complement measurements and agronomic review.
agri.liveNotice: This release processes supplied records. No live satellite or weather provider or automated image-diagnosis model is connected.
agri.recorded: Source records available; check date and method.
agri.satelliteNotice: Use surface reflectance from the same acquisition, normalized to 0–1 and aligned to a common spatial grid. Cloudy or invalid input produces no index. NDVI and LSWI do not identify a disease or measure N/P/K.
agri.irrigationNotice: Daily scenario: ETc = Kc × ETo; net = max(0, ETc − effective rain); gross = net / efficiency. Soil depletion, salinity and leaching are not modeled. Agronomic review is required; no equipment command is issued.
agri.diagnosisNotice: A reviewer records an observation against source evidence. Image diagnosis requires an attached image; there is no automated model or pesticide prescription.

services.soil: Soil analysis: N, P, K, SoC, pH

os.title: From resources to decisions.
os.subtitle: One connected core for water, energy, food, ecosystems and health. Grounded in evidence, measurement and accountability.
os.workspaceSub: A connected view of your organization. Every resource has context. Every decision has evidence.
os.illustration: Architectural illustration; no measured flows or live telemetry are represented.
os.projectEmpty: No projects in this context. Create a project to begin the evidence and decision cycle.
os.graphNotice: Recorded links, not causal claims. Open the project to inspect sources.
os.graphEmpty: No additional evidence links for this project.
os.studioSub: Compare alternatives across domains, separate hard limits from weighted objectives, and preserve inputs and results.
os.noRuns: No saved scenarios for this project.
os.matrixNotice: Declared scenario comparison, not a certified field recommendation. Feasible alternatives use min–max normalization and a weighted sum; changing alternatives can change ranking. No equipment commands are issued.
os.matrixRule: Hard limits exclude alternatives before weighting. Proposed results require a human decision.
os.pillarEvidenceSub: Source, method, time and review. Trace each result to its origin.
os.pillarDecisionSub: Resources, alternatives and limits. Calculation remains separate from human approval.
os.pillarCollaborationSub: Experts, organizations, projects and selective Data Room disclosures.
os.statusNotice: Operational development release. No projects or measurements are preloaded. Live sources, legal verification and local AI require actual configuration.
os.propose: Propose an alternative for human review
os.proposalNotice: This creates a proposal with its calculation evidence. It is not approval or execution authorization.
os.noVerifiedSources: No reviewed sources are available for this project.
os.sourcesNotice: Linking evidence records a source. It does not certify that every scenario assumption or value is measured or approved.

publicExperience.kicker: An Algerian platform for resources and sustainable production
publicExperience.title: Connected resources.
publicExperience.intro: From the field to evidence, from evidence to decisions. FOGGARA connects water, energy, food, ecosystems and health in a workspace bringing producers, engineers and organizations together around traceable projects.
publicExperience.trust: Clear sources · Human review · Role-based access

domainCopy.all: An interactive symbolic Kasria and its connected resources. Select a domain to explore it; this scene does not represent field measurements.
domainCopy.water: Manage water resources, equipment, measurements and their evidence.
domainCopy.energy: Connect energy needs and equipment data to projects and resource analysis.
domainCopy.food: Track crop, livestock and aquaculture production data and production lots.
domainCopy.ecosystem: Organize environmental indicators and references within integrated resource evaluations.
domainCopy.health: Include health indicators in the resource nexus with references and human review.

publicExperience.ecosystemBody: FOGGARA draws on Algerian knowledge of resource management and sharing. This approach connects resources, data, equipment, producers, suppliers, experts and organizations.
publicExperience.evidenceBody: Data stays connected to its source and review status. Measurements, simulations and proposals remain distinct, and results retain their stated limits.
publicExperience.projectsBody: Organize projects, resources, measurements and evidence references within your organization, then track their actions and decisions.
publicExperience.reviewBody: Separate data entry from approval and assign review to authorized roles, with rationale and audit records.
publicExperience.dataRoomBody: Organize disclosure of information and references through access requests and permissions, and track questions within the available workflow.
publicExperience.decisionTitle: Analysis informs decisions. People approve them.
publicExperience.decisionBody: Analyze alternatives, constraints and weights in the decision studio, then document approval and follow-up. Proposals remain separate from field commands and binding contracts.
publicExperience.ctaTitle: Your field needs are the starting point.
publicExperience.ctaBody: For producers, cooperatives, companies, laboratories, experts and institutions: build a collaboration workflow from a concrete problem to a measurable, reviewable result.
publicExperience.scope: Records labelled DEMO are illustrative. The scene is symbolic; external sources, field connectivity and accreditations require verification and actual configuration.
